premises.text: People lack easy visibility into health measurements that truly matter for themselves and loved ones
premises.evidence_span: how much do you really know about measurements that truly matter? Your health. And the health of your loved ones

premises.text: A multi-sensor handheld device captures dozens of health metrics in about 60 seconds and syncs via Bluetooth or a connected cradle
premises.evidence_span: It's nine integrated sensors and analytics. It's able to track 33 different health metrics. It works just as simple as a digital thermometer, and it takes only 60 seconds to get it done

premises.text: Analytics can alert care organizations to abnormalities, supporting elderly, chronic disease, hospital discharge, and consumer remote-monitoring uses
premises.evidence_span: our analytic software was able to identify and alert the facility of two abnormalities

premises.text: Revenue comes from subscriptions, OEM/licensing, and eventually data mining
premises.evidence_span: How do we make money? Through subscription base, OEM and licensing revenue

value.text: Empower people and care settings to take control of health through rapid preventive monitoring
value.evidence_span: our passion is empowering you to take control of your health

secondary_value.text: Avoid costly acute events such as strokes for patients and the system
secondary_value.evidence_span: imagine not just the money saved, but the pain and suffering that is avoided by the patient and the family
